$comment: DEF-028-006 — a pin nobody ever resolved is not a pin.
SPECIFY_VERSION was 0.0.17 for nine days. No such release exists; PyPI's specify-cli starts at 0.9.4.
T088a asserted the pin matched a three-number version pattern, which 0.0.17 does. The image could never build.
Every pin in the Dockerfile must appear here with the sha256 of an artifact that was actually resolved.
A version invented at a keyboard has no digest, so T669 fails on it.

SPECIFY_VERSION.provenance_note: PyPI metadata self-describes as 'Specify CLI, part of GitHub Spec Kit' (matches R-001) but carries no project_urls and no author. The digests pin WHICH artifact is installed; they do not attest WHO published it. Open as R-028-7.

AGENT_CLI_VERSION.provenance_note: Publisher is the AI provider named in ADR-0002. Latest at time of recording is 2.1.234; the pin is deliberate under RAID R-01 and is bumped by decision, never automatically.

NODE_MAJOR.provenance_note: A major line, not a point release — matches the repository's own Node 22 target. Deliberately coarser than the two pins above, which decide what generates specifications.
